verification_at_recording.regulatory_finding: CFTC Letter 26-05 is a conditional FCM no-action pathway based on DCO-accepted non-security digital assets and applicable DCO haircuts; it originated from Coinbase Financial Markets' request.
verification_at_recording.xrp_path: Bitnomial lists XRP as accepted collateral; a conditional FCM pathway may exist where an FCM relies on Letter 26-05 and the applicable DCO accepts XRP.
verification_at_recording.three_month_initial_phase: FCM-specific from commencement of reliance; secondary legal analysis says restrictions fall away after the initial phase. Direct FAQ text not yet reviewed.
